title: Figure 22: Gore Medical Teflon foam vascular grafts (with Figure 21 device table)
description: Photograph of several white, ribbed flexible tubes on a blue background, captioned "Figure 22. Gore Medical Teflon Foam Used in Vascular Grafts." Above it, Figure 21 is a text table titled "Medical Devices Used in the Bloodstream" listing devices such as catheters, stents, heart valves and LVADs with their blood contact times. The text notes grafts are made by Gore Medical (Flagstaff, Arizona).
